nodes.title: Step 1: Staging
widgets_values:
📍 Step 1 — Select or Build Stage
The "race_track.json" preset is loaded. Orbit (Left Drag), Pan (Right Drag), or switch presets from the dropdown.

nodes.title: Step 2: Acting
widgets_values:
🚗 Step 2 — Drive & Record
1. Practice driving freely around the track with W, A, S, D keys.
2. Click "Record" and drive for 7 seconds to capture your vehicle take.

nodes.title: Step 3: Directing
widgets_values:
🎬 Step 3 — Camera Cuts & Render
1. Scrub the timeline and click "+ Cut" to add dynamic camera angles (TPV, FPV, Tracking, Master).
2. Click "Queue Prompt" (or ▶ Render) to capture 720p HD video.

nodes.title: Step 4: Output & AI Video Reference
widgets_values:
💾 Step 4 — Output & AI Video Reference

Your crisp 720p previz MP4 is saved to ComfyUI/output/.

Use this VIDEO as reference with:
- Seedance 2.5 / Seedance 2.0 Fast (Reference-to-Video / I2V)
- MiniMax H3 Reference-to-Video

Prompt your visual style in the AI model and let Scene-Camera-Action handle the choreography and camera angles!
